problem_restatement.input: V79 grants ZEC live entry authority to a posthoc long-only Donchian slice that failed largest-winner robustness in its pseudo-holdout.
problem_restatement.required_output: Retain ZEC in the seven-asset roster while replacing that weak route only if a fixed causal mechanism survives independent, after-cost chronological evidence.
problem_restatement.success_criteria: A replacement must clear development, validation, and untouched holdout under nominal and stress friction without relying on its largest winner; otherwise no replacement is supported.

coverage_probe.revision_reason: The preregistered year-long source window does not exist at the venue; chronology was revised before inspecting OHLC values or strategy returns.

acquisition_result.reason: The observed missing-interval fraction exceeds the preregistered 0.001 maximum.

data_contract.gap_policy: reset all rolling state and do not bridge missing source bars
data_contract.future_information_policy: completed source bars only; entries begin on the next executable bar

chronology.opening_rule: Acquire without inspecting returns, run development for every fixed candidate, open validation only for candidates that clear development, and open holdout only for candidates that clear validation without parameter changes.

candidate_contracts.parameter_source: unchanged ETH/SOL dual-MTF range-onset V2 entry mechanism
candidate_contracts.signal_timeframe: completed one-minute source with completed five- and fifteen-minute context
candidate_contracts.entry: fresh range-onset cross with the inherited dual-MTF directional context condition
candidate_contracts.exit: opposite completed onset or 48-hour maximum hold

candidate_contracts.parameter_source: unchanged HYPE compression-alignment V2 entry mechanism
candidate_contracts.signal_timeframe: completed one-minute source with authoritative completed five-minute compression context
candidate_contracts.entry: fresh breakout onset after inherited compression and side-alignment conditions
candidate_contracts.exit: opposite aligned onset, eight-hour soft hold, or twenty-four-hour hard hold

candidate_contracts.entry: fresh close above the prior twenty-bar high
candidate_contracts.stop: two ATR, clamped to 20 through 250 basis points
candidate_contracts.exit: completed close below the prior ten-bar low or thirty-day maximum hold
candidate_contracts.reason: The control has already failed 2026 largest-winner robustness and cannot regain authority merely by passing an older window.

selection_contract.multiple_comparison_policy: A family-side must pass every criterion in every opened partition; no ranking or best-of-grid promotion is permitted.
selection_contract.required_runtime_parity: append invariance, no lookahead, gap reset, entry timing, stop ownership, exit timing, restart recovery, and live-provider parity tests

falsifiers: the requested source window is unavailable or exceeds the missing-interval bound
no promotion-eligible family-side clears every development criterion
a development survivor fails validation or untouched holdout
the largest winner changes a passing partition to non-positive
stress friction changes net PnL or profit factor to non-positive
any parameter or side rule is changed after its partition returns are opened
runtime parity cannot be demonstrated with deterministic tests
